notes.title: The New Version of WhiteWash is Being Tested
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players:

After more than 3 months of developing, the new version of WhiteWash has reached the final test stage, will soon meet you.

Let me show you some screenshots of the game.

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39660321/f4e510d4bd044e64f8f8b8e9b6e0c3626baf3e8e.png

Today, I have replaced all the achievement pictures, which may be different from the old version of the game, please be patient while playing the old version of the game.

If you are a new friend, you are welcome to add the game to your wish list and start this easy and healing little game at the right time.

notes.title: A Big Update is Coming Soon
LITTLE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Fixed Bugs：
1、Fixed the issue where no new Color Sprite spawning after firing Color Sprite for a long time.
2、Fixed the issue where Color Sprite sometimes not self-destruct after collision.

New Features:
1、The progress bar, by which players can better control the game progress. The progress bar can be displayed or hidden in the settings page, and is displayed by default.
